evidence.finding: Inspected the complete wrapper and inline helper. The wrapper returns when x221F_b3 is set; otherwise it conditionally spawns effect 0x43F for nonzero index, calls ftCo_800D331C, and invokes the helper. The helper conditionally calls ft_800880D8 and clears x2004, sets three flags, then calls ftCo_800BFD04.

Inspected the complete cleanup callee, extending beyond the cited L81-L126. It conditionally invokes death2_cb, death3_cb, and death1_cb; processes attached items; handles additional fighter conditions; and records motion-related state. DeathCleanup is supported by behavior rather than an existing alias.

Inspected the cited consumer and the complete direct initializer immediately preceding it. ftCo_800BFD04 explicitly enters ftCo_MS_Sleep, makes the fighter invisible, disables its camera subject, and sets x221F_b3. The consumer directly initializes one fighter and conditionally routes another player entity through ftCo_800D4F24, supporting the distinction between direct Sleep initialization and the cleanup wrapper.

unresolved.detail: The proposed name is descriptive, not a recovered original symbol. The precise meanings of effect 0x43F and several numbered flags remain unestablished; the alias does not assert those meanings.

scope: Only this exact supplement, not renewed acceptance of the underlying full TU
